interval_convention: Left closed, right open for TX and scheduled departure
routing: Existing fixed route alternatives and nested draws; no replacement of demand
eligibility: Scheduled departure in window, originally exposed, existing lane-preflighted alternative. Include eligible noncompliers, missed insertion/decision points, transport/audit failures in denominator.
rationale: Fixed 300s background warm-up,10s receiver startup,60s cohort window,20s remaining TX support. No selecting windows from emissions, realized arrivals, packet delivery or auditor outcomes.
